name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology PhD
summary: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology doctorate admitting students to individual faculty advisers or occasional co-advisers.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Annual December 31 deadline has no year; stipend is explicitly 2026–27.

publishedDeadlines.label: Full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Fall application opens September 1; late applications may be considered when possible. No explicitly dated Fall 2027 deadline.

applicationFee.note: US citizens/PR and applicants whose most recent degree is from a US college/university may email EEB admissions before submitting. Listed participant routes include McNair, GCURS, Mellon Mays, Project 1000, Nankai Hundred Young Teachers and Vietnam Education Foundation; indicate programme participation in application. International applicants should confirm eligible affiliation; no general overseas hardship route established. Fees nonrefundable.

english.note: Central proof routes include accredited US high-school/college/university degree or completed/expected post-secondary degree at English-official instruction institution; consult official country/institution lists and enter institution accurately with language English. Home Edition accepted; best composite only, not MyBest. Do not generalize historical 2021 IELTSIndicator wording to current acceptance.

documents: Unofficial transcripts for preliminary review; official records required once selected for interview, final transcripts for work in progress
Recommendations requested from four people, preferably major-field professors; at least three received before review
PDF personal statement describing intended study/research subdivision and relevant background
English evidence unless eligible degree meets requirement
requirements.note: BA/BS or equivalent with strong biology preparation; other majors eligible. Ecology, evolution/equivalent, calculus and statistics preparation expected; deficiencies made up first year unless approved waiver. Identify/contact prospective advisers before applying to confirm availability and research compatibility. General GRE optional without disadvantage if omitted; Biology subject optional. Separate applications required for separate graduate programs.

funding.note: PhDs without external fellowship receive programme stipend including summer plus tuition waiver. Continuation after first year requires good standing; lower external awards supplemented to programme level. The stipend/tuition policy applies to doctoral students, with continuation extended to all students in good standing, including international students. Health-insurance coverage not established.
